channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Fighting escalates in Yemen; Houthi attacks trigger alerts in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Yemen's government accuses Houthis of killing three children as rebels claim Saudi forces launched 54 air raids in 12 hours.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russian Caspian Sea port in Dagestan
item.description: Fires and explosions were seen in Russia’s Dagestan after a Ukrainian drone attack.

item.title: Why is Iran bombing Jordan’s Al-Azraq base?
item.description: Iran has increased its targeting of Jordan’s Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Al-Azraq in recent weeks.

item.title: Tunisian flotilla activists remain jailed as hunger striker worsens
item.description: The four have been held since March in a financial investigation linked to organisers of the Global Sumud Flotilla.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran media say ‘enemy’ projectiles hit Sirik areas
item.description: Tehran says ready for dialogue with nations in the region to 'foster mutual trust' and 'achieve sustainable security'.

item.title: Trump says the US-Iran war will end right after midterms
item.description: Seven months after launching the war on Iran, US President Donald Trump says it will end immediately after midterms.

item.title: Iran war looms over Trump at Republican midterm convention in Dallas
item.description: Trump supporters say he can rally Republican voters despite concerns over the unpopular war and rising prices.

item.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
item.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

item.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
item.description: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

item.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
item.description: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.
